episodes.title: Operation Atlantik
episodes.summary: France 1941: A young war correspondent deploys with a German submarine. He doesn't know yet how fast the war will rear it's ugly head

episodes.title: Auf Suchkurs
episodes.summary: Lethargy quickly turns into enthusiasm as U96 goes in pursuit of British ships. But suddenly, the hunter becomes the hunted...

episodes.title: Der erste Angriff
episodes.summary: U96 is hit hard and the crew fears for their lives. A storm moves in, and the captain has to keep his wits if he wants to save his boat and his crew.

episodes.title: Himmelfahrtskommando
episodes.summary: The submarine was hit hard, but manages to get away. They are under orders to approach Italy, but Gibraltar is under British control.

episodes.title: Auf Grund
episodes.summary: After landing in Spain, the crew is relieved -- finally, they are safe. But soon, an air raid forces the submarine back to the bottom of the sea.

episodes.title: In der Heimat
episodes.summary: U96 gets away in the nick of time, and the crew takes course on France. But on the way, another attack results in a deathly inferno.
